    def inside(r, c):
        return 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w

    def winner(values):
        values = set(values)
        for a in colors:

        return min(values) if values else 0

        for r, c in twos:

            votes = []
            for dr, dc in directions:
                nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
                if inside(nr, nc):
                    value = original[nr][nc]
                    if value in colors:
                        votes.append(value)
                    elif value == 2 and (nr, nc) in assigned:
                        votes.append(assigned[(nr, nc)])
            if votes:

        if not updates:
            break

        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(1, w - 1):

                        (r, c + 1) in masks[color] and
                        (r, c) not in masks[color]):

        for r in range(1, h - 1):
            for c in range(w):
                if ((r - 1, c) in masks[color] and
                        (r + 1, c) in masks[color] and
                        (r, c) not in masks[color]):
                    gaps[color]["v"].add((r, c))

    rays = {color: set() for color in colors}

            options = []
            for dr, dc in directions:

                    continue
                color = base[pr][pc]
                geometry = masks[color] | gaps[color]["h"] | gaps[color]["v"]
                rr, cc = pr + dr, pc + dc
                score = 0
                while inside(rr, cc) and (rr, cc) in geometry:
                    score += 1
                    rr += dr
                    cc += dc
                options.append(((pr, pc), color, score))
            if not options:
                continue
            best = max(item[2] for item in options)
            candidates = [item for item in options if item[2] == best]
            color = winner(item[1] for item in candidates)
            pivot = next(item[0] for item in candidates if item[1] == color)

            pr, pc = pivot
            dr, dc = qr - pr, qc - pc
            start = (pr - dr, pc - dc)
            geometry = masks[color] | gaps[color]["h"] | gaps[color]["v"]
            if start in geometry:
                stack = [start]
                removed = set()
                while stack:
                    cell = stack.pop()
                    if cell == pivot or cell in removed or cell not in geometry:
                        continue
                    removed.add(cell)
                    rr, cc = cell
                    for ar, ac in directions:
                        neighbor = (rr + ar, cc + ac)
                        if neighbor != pivot and neighbor in geometry:
                            stack.append(neighbor)
                for rr, cc in removed:
                    masks[color].discard((rr, cc))
                    gaps[color]["h"].discard((rr, cc))
                    gaps[color]["v"].discard((rr, cc))
                    if base[rr][cc] == color:
                        base[rr][cc] = 0

            rr, cc = pivot
            while inside(rr, cc):
                rays[color].add((rr, cc))
                rr += dr
                cc += dc

    proposals = {}
    for color in colors:
        for cell in gaps[color]["h"] | gaps[color]["v"] | rays[color]:
            proposals.setdefault(cell, set()).add(color)

    output = [row[:] for row in base]
    for (r, c), proposed in proposals.items():
        present = set(proposed)
        if base[r][c] in colors:
            present.add(base[r][c])
        output[r][c] = winner(present)
    return output
